findings.passage: “We must remain unwavering in our commitment to ensuring that every ballot is legitimate, every voter is properly identified, and our state’s ballot counting process is fast and efficient,” Sen. Choi continued.
findings.note: Press release from his Senate office after the 2025-04-01 Senate Elections Committee hearing on SB 405, SB 406 and SB 407; he links voter identification to election integrity.

findings.passage: “This bill package will ensure that California elections are fast, efficient, and secure. It is unacceptable that our state takes more than a month to count ballots while states with a fraction of our resources can project results on Election Night,” stated Senator Choi.
findings.note: Release from his Senate office introducing a package of election bills including SB 405, which would repeal SB 1174 (2024) and let local governments require voter ID in local elections.

findings.passage: “Californians have made it clear that they support requiring a government ID to vote,” said Senator Choi.
findings.note: Release from his Senate office on SB 405; he says the bill restores local choice on voter ID.

findings.passage: “This is a commonsense measure that protects the constitutional right of local governments to require proof of identification to vote,” Choi concluded.
findings.note: Same release; he describes SB 405 and a motion he made to move it out of committee.

findings.passage: “Accurate voter rolls are fundamental to maintaining public trust in our elections,” said Senator Choi.
findings.note: Release on SB 1310, which has jury commissioners share information about jurors who say they are ineligible, so counties can update or check voter registration records.

findings.passage: “I fully support putting this important measure to the voters so that they can decide if they want secure elections in California,” Choi said.
findings.note: Quoted by The Center Square (via Just the News) on Prop 39, the November 2026 voter ID ballot measure; he also says he strongly supports it.
